Help.title: Help centre
Help.intro: Short answers to common questions. Some features are still being built; they are marked "Coming soon".

items.q: How do I find a product by its part number?
items.a: Type the manufacturer part number into the search box at the top of any page. Capital letters, spaces and dashes do not matter, and small typing mistakes are tolerated.

items.q: What if I cannot find the part I need?
items.a: Requests for a quote on a part you cannot find are being built.

items.q: Can my company have an account?
items.a: Yes. A company account holds the company profile (trade licence, BIN and TIN). Signed-in companies see prices without VAT, with the VAT shown as a separate line.

items.q: Can I get a quote or buy on credit?
items.a: Quotes (valid for 15 days by default) and credit terms for approved companies are being built.

items.q: Do I get a VAT invoice?
items.a: Mushak-6.3 VAT invoices are being built.
Planned for launch. Checkout is not open yet.

items.q: Credit terms (net 15 or net 30) for approved companies
items.a: Planned for launch, only for companies approved by MECHWARE finance.
Planned for small orders in serviceable areas only, with a phone code check.

items.q: Where do you deliver and what does it cost?
items.a: Delivery areas are Inside Dhaka, Dhaka suburbs and Outside Dhaka. International orders and heavy or oversize items are by quote only. The delivery fee is shown before you pay. Rates: [to be confirmed].
Under the Digital Commerce Operation Guidelines 2021, delivery is due within 5 days in the same city and 10 days in another city, counted from order confirmation.
By default within 7 days after delivery, but each product has its own policy. Electrical parts that were opened or installed cannot be returned unless they are faulty.

items.q: How do I get my money back?
items.a: Refunds go to the original payment method or as a credit note. The refund deadline is [to be confirmed].
